params.body:
Standard 0.21.0 (Trendwolves/gentells-standard#28): only recorded publisher terms that forbid a paid product (`non-commercial`, `forbidden`, in `citable.refusePublisherTerms`) stop a citation. Since nobody looks terms up any more (0.20.0), the old rule would have kept every newly admitted publisher's figures uncitable for "the publisher's terms are unknown".

- `statisticCitable` reads `citable.refusePublisherTerms` instead of `admit.allowTerms`.
- `cite-statistics` tests: a publisher without terms is taken; a non-commercial one is still refused.
- `packages/core/standard.mjs` synced from tag v0.21.0.

`npm test`: 1832 pass, `tsc` clean. One earlier run had two `cite-statistics` tests fail ("a figure under a post says so"); the file alone and the next two full runs pass.
params.title: A statistic from a publisher with unknown terms can be cited
